purpose: Create one uniformly sanitized and sealed perception mesh for each frozen parent after M1 exposed one zero-area face and incorrect preview stage labels.

approval.scope: One M1R implementation and one full-100 formal execution with uniform zero-area sanitation, correct train labels and zero downstream scope.
approval.confirmation_reference: User replied 继续 after the exact M1R proposal.

source.reuse_policy: No failed M1 mesh is copied; regenerate all 100 once under the M1R contract.

sanitation_contract.action: remove only matching OBJ face lines while preserving every vertex line and reloaded vertex coordinate exactly

split_isolation: Only 80 train maps are rendered and manually reviewed with M1R label; validation/development-test receive frozen automatic checks only.
failure_policy: Any source, sanitation, quality, visualization, split or seal failure stops and seals FAIL without retry.
next_stage_boundary: M1R PASS permits only a separate CPU LiDAR and objective-label contract proposal.
